inputs.name: server
inputs.description: One k3s server to run Helm on: an address, or a host object with an address and optional host_key, user, port, private_key_file or jump_hosts.

inputs.name: hostname
inputs.description: DNS name Rancher answers on. Every node that joins Rancher must be able to resolve it. A name such as rancher.203.0.113.10.sslip.io will do for a trial.

inputs.name: bootstrap_password
inputs.description: Password for the first login as admin. Rancher asks for a new one then, so it only matters until that first login.

inputs.name: rancher_version
inputs.description: Rancher chart version from the stable repository, without a v. Change it with rancher_chart_sha256 and k3s_minors.

inputs.name: rancher_chart_sha256
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the Rancher chart, rancher-VERSION.tgz.

inputs.name: k3s_minors
inputs.description: Kubernetes minor versions the server's k3s may run, from the release notes of rancher_version. Anything else fails the apply before Rancher is touched.

inputs.name: cert_manager_version
inputs.description: cert-manager chart version. Change it with cert_manager_chart_sha256.

inputs.name: cert_manager_chart_sha256
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the cert-manager chart, cert-manager-VERSION.tgz.

inputs.name: helm_version
inputs.description: Helm release to install under /var/lib/conn3x-rancher. Rancher's docs ask for Helm 3. Change it with helm_checksums.

inputs.name: helm_checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the Helm tarball for each architecture, from get.helm.sh.

inputs.name: replicas
inputs.description: Rancher pods. A negative number means up to that many, one per node, so -3 runs one on a single node and three on three.

inputs.name: chart_values
inputs.description: More Helm values for the Rancher chart, such as { ingress = { tls = { source = "letsEncrypt" } } }. They replace hostname and replicas if they name them. The bootstrap password can't go here, since these reach state.
